sermon.title: Sheep
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches from John 10 that the Lord made us and is our shepherd: Jesus is the good shepherd who gave his life and the only door to salvation. He contrasts the hireling who works for money and flees with honest delegated leaders, warns of wolves in sheep’s clothing and false doctrines, and explains being practical as serpents and pure as doves.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: “Psalms 103 verse 3 or 100 verse 3” (Psalm 100:3); “no record in Egyptian history” of the magicians’ signs; no women angels and angels without sexual organs as spoken; “since the 70s Christ will not come in my lifetime.” Sensitive content kept as spoken: Joseph Smith, Muhammad, Mary Baker Eddy and Buddha named as not the way; Islam called wrong and not a religion of peace; Chick-fil-A protest sign calling homosexuals criminals, liars and bullies; megachurch ministers’ income-tax and alcohol remarks; Catholic priests and nuns; homosexuals, secular humanists and atheists uniting against the church.

faqs.question: Did we come from evolution?
faqs.answer: No—the Lord made us, not we ourselves.

faqs.question: What marks the good shepherd?
faqs.answer: He gives his life for the sheep.

faqs.question: Why use a concordance or Bible dictionary?
faqs.answer: To look up Bible words, since the King James isn’t perfect.

faqs.question: Can Christians disagree on doctrine?
faqs.answer: On many things, but not on Jesus.

faqs.question: What must we do to be saved?
faqs.answer: Call on Jesus, confess him as Lord, believe God raised him from the dead.

faqs.question: What causes church splits?
faqs.answer: Hirelings who let the wolf in and people seeking their own gain.

faqs.question: Are angels male or female?
faqs.answer: He says angels have no sexual organs; they are neither male nor female.

faqs.question: What does “wise” mean in “wise as serpents”?
Does John 10 teach once saved, always saved?
faqs.answer: He says the promise is for sheep who hear his voice and follow him.
